# Original joint-LAW table inlet for G7

SOURCE ONLY, UNCOMPILED/UNEXECUTED. No Rust/Cargo/native/backend/model/CI or
new proof/literal suite ran. This module is not a complete source census,
controller binding, executable policy or full G7 closure.

native/g7_law_table_inlet.rs reuses the exact original law::compile and sparse
Polynomial type, exposed by the new frontend's law_table_inlet module. It
adds no source grammar, biological compiler, solver, process or record writer.
The existing original LAW32-bank/4-sample/state/term/history limits are retained.

## One source across forcing rows AND sampling menus

FamilyInput declares original taxon/hybrid counts, the exact ordered forcing
rows and a finite list of ReadoutMenu values. Each menu preserves its complete
Copy-position-to-original-taxon map and finite rooted/unrooted readout map.
Every model retains one original law::Request source/mechanism/budget template
whose samples equal menu0. Other menu requests copy that SAME source/mechanism/
budget and substitute only the declared sample array. Original edge/hybrid
occurrences and parent arrays are never renumbered.

Each natural model/menu table is compiled ONCE by the existing joint-frontier
engine. Every forcing row specializes that same table. All menus and rows are
then placed inside ONE SourceModel with ONE original parameter bank. Different
source alternatives get different models/banks. Menus are never extra source
alternatives, physical configuration IDs, per-row source fits or products of
quartet marginals. A same-locus joint readout is a grouping of the full joint
genealogy table, not a product of separately projected observations.

Native variable order is original x_e survival coordinates followed by native
G_h, with G_h=P(incoming[0]). For each original forcing bit:

| Original row entry | Polynomial operation | Source interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| None | Retain the same G_h variable | Original natural coin/mode retained |
| Some false | Set polynomial G_h to1 | Route every current owner to parent0 |
| Some true | Set polynomial G_h to0 | Route every current owner to parent1 |

Specialization drops monomials containing a positive forced-zero exponent,
zeros forced exponents in retained terms and combines exact rational
coefficients. All untouched variables keep their positions. Constants, if
declared by the outer problem, are prefixed as zero exponents. The natural
source domain remains0<x_e<1 and0<G_h<1 for EVERY original coordinate, even
if a forced row no longer depends on that G_h. This does NOT set the source's
strict natural inheritance to an endpoint or refit its other rows.

The existing OriginalFixedIDControls source explicitly uses unitInterval
endpoint control parameters, preserves the original HybridProbabilities and
unforced COMMON registers, and makes forced current-owner pulses deterministic.
Its true/parent1 parameter is the complement of native G. Thus the M0 false/
true registry convention still requires natural G=1-physical_gamma. These
existing source definitions were read and pinned; no fresh kernel check or
native-polynomial/controlled-law refinement is inferred from that read.

## Complete readouts and the concatenation boundary

Readout maps every canonical native terminal key to one finite outcome.
Missing ANY occurring key aborts the family. Extra keys are allowed because
another source may have different support. Projected and forced formal mass
are checked to be1 for EACH menu using exact polynomial arithmetic.

Base order is [original row][menu0 outcomes,menu1 outcomes,...]; menu_offsets
bind the literal boundaries. Several menu law blocks are a concatenated real
base vector, NOT one normalized PMF. Consequently into_problem rejects
StochasticChannels when there is more than one menu. The explicit
StochasticMenuChannels representation now derives w(row)*q(row,menu)*channel
with separate normalized menu choices, binding each ordered outcome count to
this inlet's actual menus. General SuppliedAffine remains available with its
actual-programme semantic proof obligation. A single-menu probability base
can still use the original w*channel shorthand. No undeclared menu mixture or
new original actuator is invented. This extension is SOURCE ONLY.

The game compiler already supports a general affine base vector. This inlet's
finite multi-menu representation therefore keeps D=rows*sum(menu outcomes),
all whole-history equations and original support PATH costs. Observation/menu
alternatives do not silently become new charged original forcing rows.

## Output/error and provenance contract

prepare() either returns the COMPLETE PreparedFamily or aborts. It never skips
a failed model/menu, truncates a readout or returns a successful census prefix.
A native state/term/history limit is retained with model_index, menu_index and
its exact original Limit object. Unsupported old engine dimensions/sample caps
and inlet construction limits are Unknown/unavailable, never no-source or
budget NO. Malformed declarations are Invalid; original validator/internal
errors remain NativeFailure, also never scientific NO.

Preflight checks the original size bounds BEFORE old Request.validate can
allocate per-vertex arrays. Original graph validation and the inherited engine
are unchanged. Source/hash/bit/term/cell/operation/scope/key bounds are source
guards, not a claimed cgroup/RSS limit or transitive writer enforcement.

PreparedFamily.into_problem checks target/constant scope and preserves a
SupplierBinding borrowing the complete original FamilyInput. BoundProblem
returns the Problem together with that binding; explicit detachment returns
both. This is an immutable declaration association, not authentication of an
arbitrary external dictionary, original request bytes or executed native result.
Actual request/source/row/menu/order identities and exact result/check records
must still be bound by the existing authenticated provider/controller.
